description: Register a dagster-aws S3Resource for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

aws_access_key_id_env_var.label: AWS Access Key ID Env Var
aws_access_key_id_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the AWS access key ID

aws_secret_access_key_env_var.label: AWS Secret Access Key Env Var
aws_secret_access_key_env_var.description: Environment variable holding the AWS secret access key

endpoint_url.label: Endpoint URL
endpoint_url.description: Custom endpoint URL for MinIO or LocalStack, e.g. 'http://localhost:9000'

profile_name.label: Profile Name
profile_name.description: Named AWS CLI/SDK profile (from ~/.aws/credentials) to source credentials from. Mutually exclusive in practice with the access-key-id/secret env vars and role_arn -- whichever credential source is set, boto3's own resolution order applies.

aws_session_token_env_var.label: Aws Session Token Env Var
aws_session_token_env_var.description: Environment variable holding a temporary AWS session token (paired with the access key/secret above for STS-issued temporary credentials you already have -- for assuming a role yourself, use role_arn instead).

role_arn.label: Role Arn
role_arn.description: ARN of an IAM role to assume via STS (dagster-aws's S3Resource has no native assume-role support -- this component calls sts:AssumeRole itself and passes the resulting temporary credentials to S3Resource). IMPORTANT: the role is assumed ONCE, when this code location loads, not per-materialization -- the temporary credentials are good for role_duration_seconds (default 3600s/1h). A long-lived code server process may need to reload before they expire. Not a continuously-refreshing credential provider; for that, assume the role outside Dagster and set the access key/secret/session-token env vars above instead.

role_session_name.label: Role Session Name
role_session_name.description: RoleSessionName for the assumed-role session. Only used when role_arn is set.

role_external_id.label: Role External Id
role_external_id.description: ExternalId for the assumed-role call, if the role's trust policy requires one. Only used when role_arn is set.

role_duration_seconds.label: Role Duration Seconds
role_duration_seconds.description: Requested STS session duration in seconds for role_arn (default 3600/1h; up to 43200/12h if the role's maximum session duration allows it).

name: AWS S3 Resource
